bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to construction codes; exempting certain well contractors from Department of Labor and Industry plan review and inspection requirements; clarifying existing exemptions to contractor licensing, registration, and bonding requirements; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 326B.43, by adding a subdivision; 326B.46, subdivision 6.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 326B.43, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 7.+]

[+Well contractor exemption.+]

[+A well contractor or a limited well/boring contractor is exempt from plan and specification reviews and inspections under this chapter if the contractor is: +]

[+(1) licensed and bonded under section 103I.525 or 103I.531; +]

[+(2) performing work approved under section 144.383; and +]

[+(3) engaged in the work or business of designing and installing: +]

[+(i) water service or supply pipes from or between a well, a water supply storage tank system, the final pressure tanks, and the master shutoff valve leading to distribution; +]

[+(ii) a frost-free water hydrant with an antisiphon device located outside of a building requiring potable water; +]

[+(iii) a control valve, located outside the building, on a well water service pipe; or +]

[+(iv) a master shutoff valve located within three feet of the final pressure tank leading to the distribution line. +]

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 326B.46, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Well contractor exempt from licensing and bond; conditions.

[-(1) water service pipe from a well to a pressure tank; -]

[-(2) a frost-free water hydrant with an antisiphon device on a well water service pipe located entirely outside of a building requiring potable water; -]

[-(3) a control valve, located outside the building, on a well water service pipe; or -]

[-(4) a main control valve located within two feet of the pressure tank on the distribution supply line. -]

[+(1) licensed and bonded under section 103I.525 or 103I.531; +]

[+(2) performing work approved under section 144.383; and +]

[+(3) engaged in the work or business of designing and installing: +]

[+(i) water service or supply pipes from or between a well, a water supply storage tank system, the final pressure tanks, and the master shutoff valve leading to distribution; +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to construction codes; exempting certain well contractors from Department of Labor and Industry plan review and inspection requirements; clarifying existing exemptions to contractor licensing, registration, and bonding requirements; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 326B.43, by adding a subdivision; 326B.46, subdivision 6.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 326B.43, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7.

Well contractor exemption.

A well contractor or a limited well/boring contractor is exempt from plan and specification reviews and inspections under this chapter if the contractor is:

(1) licensed and bonded under section 103I.525 or 103I.531;

(2) performing work approved under section 144.383; and

(3) engaged in the work or business of designing and installing:

(i) water service or supply pipes from or between a well, a water supply storage tank system, the final pressure tanks, and the master shutoff valve leading to distribution;

(ii) a frost-free water hydrant with an antisiphon device located outside of a building requiring potable water;

(iii) a control valve, located outside the building, on a well water service pipe; or

(iv) a master shutoff valve located within three feet of the final pressure tank leading to the distribution line.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 326B.46, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Well contractor exempt from licensing and bond; conditions.
No license, registration, or bond under sections 326B.42 to 326B.49 is required of a well contractor or a limited well/boring contractor who is :

(1) licensed and bonded under section 103I.525 or 103I.531;

(2) performing work approved under section 144.383; and

(3) engaged in the work or business of designing and installing:

(i) water service or supply pipes from or between a well, a water supply storage tank system, the final pressure tanks, and the master shutoff valve leading to distribution;

(ii) a frost-free water hydrant with an antisiphon device located outside of a building requiring potable water;

(iii) a control valve, located outside the building, on a well water service pipe; or

(iv) a master shutoff valve located within three feet of the final pressure tank leading to the distribution line.
